title: Company Drop-Off Lot Credit for Surrendered Vehicles (Repossession and Collateral Recovery)
content:
Storage operations note on vehicles surrendered at a company drop-off lot under Repossession and Collateral Recovery.

**Rule.** Where the case's storage lot is one of the company drop-off lots (Peachtree Auto Holding - Forest Park; Lake Erie Auto Storage - Cleveland) and the recovery date fell on a weekday, the borrower delivered the vehicle to a staffed company drop-off lot and a drop-off credit of 50.00 applies; where the storage lot is one of the company drop-off lots and the recovery date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday, the borrower left the vehicle at the lot's after-hours drop and a drop-off credit of 25.00 applies; at any other lot no drop-off credit applies.

Weekdays are read from the ordinary calendar for the recovery date on the case (5 January 2026 being a Monday).

| Storage lot on the case | Recovery date | Drop-off credit |
|---|---|---|
| Peachtree Auto Holding - Forest Park or Lake Erie Auto Storage - Cleveland | Monday to Friday | 50.00 (staffed drop-off) |
| Peachtree Auto Holding - Forest Park or Lake Erie Auto Storage - Cleveland | Saturday or Sunday | 25.00 (after-hours drop) |
| any other lot | any day | none |

*Example (hypothetical):* a vehicle recorded at Lake Erie Auto Storage - Cleveland with a recovery date of Sunday 11 January 2026 earns the after-hours credit of 25.00; the same vehicle recorded at another lot earns no credit.
